entries.title: Activity no longer shows lines that give you nothing to do
entries.body: Leftover task branches from earlier work are now cleaned up when Infinitary starts, with their work saved first, instead of a line listing them at every start. A task that has gone quiet for ten minutes no longer adds a line to Activity; its own record still says so. A memory warning now names the programs outside your tasks when they hold more memory than any task. A task paused while Infinitary itself updates no longer names a computer called "undefined".
entries.noPicture: The change removes or rewords Activity lines; leftover branches go with nothing on screen.
